scope: Planning overlay only. Does not mutate canonical task status, execution authority, frozen weights or operational holds.

lanes.title: Historical reconciliation
lanes.objective: Triage stale PRs and completed Sprint 3 issues without reimplementing accepted work
lanes.exit: Each item disposition recorded with evidence and no duplicate active implementation

lanes.title: Decision integrity and market-data freshness
lanes.objective: Falsify stale price/live macro, expired UI cache, OHLCV provenance, canonical execution gating and misleading readiness UX
lanes.entry: PREFLIGHT-001 existing scope, only confirmed defects
lanes.exit: Tests, scoped PR if necessary, qualified release and updated blockers

lanes.title: Radar discovery reliability
lanes.objective: Quantify published universe discovery quality, freshness and truthful filters without natural scanner activation
lanes.entry: Evidence-only qualification and bounded non-activating fixes
lanes.exit: Source-backed Stage 2/membership evidence, measured category availability

lanes.title: Smart Money evidence quality
lanes.objective: Point-in-time NVDA/Form 4 evidence, cohort quality and settlement without recurring egress
lanes.entry: Read-only audit; independent canary authorization required
lanes.exit: Source freshness report and prospective cohort quality, not unsupported calibration

lanes.title: Security and architecture hardening
lanes.objective: Close only confirmed remaining trust-boundary, runtime ownership and build provenance risks after SEC-002
lanes.exit: Distinct verified gaps closed with regression tests or explicitly deferred

lanes.title: Owner-gated holding queue
lanes.objective: Track ten blocked + one authorization-held canonical tasks and dormant activation/research PRs
lanes.entry: Owner approval separate from planning is mandatory
lanes.exit: Retain HOLD unless separately authorized; no automatic carryforward into active sprint

policy: P0 and P1 can be worked pragmatically under their respective existing approval boundaries. The HOLD lane and Sprint 5 activation remain owner-gated.
